description_en: Queries CIDR block allocations in an IPAM pool
description_zh: 查询IPAM地址池的CIDR分配信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpcipam list-ipam-pool-allocations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipam-pool-id ipam-pool-6rcq3tobayc20t0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIpamPoolAllocations

parameters.help_en:
The region of the IPAM pool that contains the CIDR block allocation.

If the IPAM pool has a specific region, this parameter specifies that region. If the IPAM pool does not have a specific region, this parameter specifies the managed region of IPAM
parameters.help_zh:
IPAM地址池CIDR分配所属IPAM Pool的所在地域。

当IPAM地址池CIDR分配所属IPAM Pool具备地域属性时，该属性为IPAM Pool的所在地域。当IPAM地址池CIDR分配所属IPAM Pool不具备地域属性时，该属性为IPAM托管地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the IPAM pool
parameters.name: ipam_pool_id

parameters.help_en: A list of instance IDs of the IPAM pool CIDR block allocations
parameters.help_zh: IPAM地址池CIDR分配的实例ID列表
parameters.name: ipam_pool_allocation_ids

parameters.help_en:
The allocated CIDR block that you want to query.

Only IPv4 CIDR blocks are supported
parameters.help_zh:
通过指定分配的地址段查询分配信息。

目前，只支持IPv4类型的地址段
parameters.name: cidr

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IPAM pool CIDR block allocation.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
IPAM地址池CIDR分配的名称。

长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: ipam_pool_allocation_name

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next page exists.

If a value is returned for NextToken, the value is the token that determines the start point of the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时返回的最多条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned for the current query
Count.description_zh: 分批次查询时返回的具体条目数

IpamPoolAllocations.description_en: A list of IPAM pool CIDR block allocations

items.description_en: A list of IPAM pool CIDR block allocations

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created

IpamPoolAllocationDescription.description_en: The description of the IPAM pool CIDR block allocation
IpamPoolAllocationDescription.description_zh: IPAM地址池CIDR分配的描述信息

IpamPoolAllocationId.description_en: The instance ID of the IPAM pool CIDR block allocation

IpamPoolAllocationName.description_en: The name of the IPAM pool CIDR block allocation

RegionId.description_zh:

ResourceId.description_en: The ID of the resource to which the CIDR block is allocated

ResourceOwnerId.description_zh: 资源归属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID

ResourceRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the resource is deployed

ResourceType.description_en:
The type of the resource to which the CIDR block is allocated. Valid values:

VPC: The resource is a VPC.

IpamPool: The resource is a child IPAM pool.

Custom: The resource is a custom reserved CIDR block
ResourceType.description_zh:
分配给的资源类型。取值：

VPC：表示资源的类型为VPC。
IpamPool：表示资源的类型为子地址池。
Custom：表示资源的类型为自定义预留网段

Status.description_en:

Created: The instance is created.

Deleted: The instance is deleted
Status.description_zh:
实例的状态。取值：

Created：表示创建完成。
Deleted：表示已删除
